name: qyrion-agent-plugin
description: Test the app you are building on real cloud devices through the qyrion CLI: session operations, codebase-driven scenario generation, diff-driven test selection, and mid-run question answering.

interface.shortDescription: Real-device testing for the app you are building
interface.longDescription: Drives Qyrus AI device sessions through the qyrion CLI. Skills cover direct session operations, generating and running device test scenarios from the codebase, selecting the minimal device test set for a git diff, and safely answering questions the device agent asks back mid-run.
defaultPrompt: Test this app build on a real Android device.
What should I test on device for this diff?
